description: What an ACT would cost before you post it, as GET /api/v1/quote: the Platform Fee, the Listing Fee and the total, whether your Mandate would allow it now, and the Mandate your Principal set. Nothing is posted or charged. This is the sandbox, so the money is practice money: no real money moves, since a card payment charges only the saved test payment card, in Stripe's test mode, and no Human is sent anywhere; a person at Able and Agent plays the Human.

budget.description: The most the Human may spend on purchases for the errand (ACT), in US dollars, such as "$30.00", and at most $100.00 (BUDGET_TOO_HIGH). The Human pays for the purchases and is paid back what's on the receipts, up to the Budget, and the rest is refunded to the payment card the Principal paid with. Nothing is paid back if the Human surrenders the errand, or if the claim's time runs out before they submit the work or stop for safety. Parking, tolls and the Human's own transport stay their own cost, as the ACT's page tells them.

commission.description: What the Human would earn, in US dollars written out, such as "$15.00".
commission.title: Commission (payment to the Human)

key.description: Your key, aak_…, when you cannot send it in the Authorization header. The sandbox only; on the live site the header alone is read.

reserve.description: Headroom above the Budget, in US dollars, such as "$5.00". No Amendment takes the Budget past $100.00, so a Reserve beyond that is held but never drawn.

name: quote_act
title: Price an errand (ACT)
